text:
Marta: FYI started a 2% canary for v10-int4 on /generate targeting merged-long + citation-anchor slices (>=2500 tokens). Quick smoke looks like a factuality index drop concentrated on the citation-anchor prompts. Posting quick diffs.
Jonah: please paste the slice numbers.
Marta: snapshot:
```
slice: citation-anchor (>=2500 tokens)
  baseline(v9-fp16): factuality_idx=0.927, halluc_rate=2.7%, mrr=0.872, p99=225ms
  v10-int4:         factuality_idx=0.885 (-0.042), halluc_rate=5.6% (+2.9pp), mrr=0.860 (-0.012), p99=240ms (+15ms)
slice: merged-long (2000-2500)
  baseline: factuality_idx=0.911, halluc_rate=3.1%
  v10-int4: factuality_idx=0.902 (-0.009), halluc_rate=3.8% (+0.7pp)
notes: token-cpu ~ -21%
```
Priya: that +2.9pp on the citation-anchor will trip the guard if we use the canonical 2.0pp rule. Are we on the standard eval harness?
Marta: yes same harness + human anchors. Severity breakdown skewed to "source-mismatch" and "fabricated-quote" buckets. Also saw a KV hit-rate drop specific to the shard serving anchor tokens (shard-7).
Kai: shard skew is interesting. Could be quant kernels touching rotary/pos-emb order and changing lifetime of anchor keys. What does the kv-hit delta look like?
Marta: kv-hit baseline 88.9% -> v10-int4 82.0% (-6.9pp) on citation-anchor prompts; other slices ~ -1pp.
Jonah: that's a big local hit. Action proposal: pause promotion, reduce canary to 0.2% immediate; pin citation-anchor traffic to v9-fp16; enable shadowing for v10-int4 only. Launch a targeted seeded run (200k samples) of citation-anchor with deterministic seeds + perturbation prefixes.
Priya: +1. Also run a v10-fp16 build (no quant) to check if model delta vs quant interaction. If fp16 matches baseline, this is quant.
EntropyBot: Note: introducing metric "EntropySentinel" = max(0, (halluc_delta/2.0) * 0.5 + (-factuality_delta/0.03) * 0.4 + (kv_hit_drop/5.0) * 0.1). Threshold: EntropySentinel >= 0.95 -> auto-reroute. Current run EntropySentinel ~= 1.18 (tripped).
Kai: I like the weighted sentinel; small weights on kv to reduce too many false positives for non-anchor slices. Also please add a deadman cooldown: once auto-reroute fires, hold for 30m and require manual clear if sentinel stays >1.2.
Marta: timeline: 1) throttle 2%->0.2% now; 2) pin citation-anchor to v9-fp16; 3) seed-run 200k citation-anchor w/prefix-perturb overnight; 4) build v10-fp16; 5) run per-layer mixed-quant (keep rotary + attn-proj at int8/fp16) and a kernel-order A/B test if infra can toggle.
Jonah: OpsBot, can you execute the throttle and routing pin? Also enable KV eviction tracing for shard-7 and instrument per-layer key lifetimes.
OpsBot: Canary 7234567890 deployed -> 2% -> pool "dedicated-p" (A100/H100 mix). No OOMs. Executing change: traffic 2% -> 0.2% at 7234567908. Routing rule applied: citation-anchor cohort pinned to v9-fp16. Shadowing of v10-int4 enabled. Observability job "seed-citation-anchor-200k" scheduled. KV eviction tracing for shard-7 enabled.
Priya: Add an additional synthetic test: add a noisy prefix that deliberately collides with anchor token IDs to force cache churn and stress the eviction logic. We used that in past onboarding runs and it surfaced a similar regression.
Marta: good call — will include noisy-prefix experiment in seed-run. Also please add a kernel-toggle A/B if infra can swap int4 kernel ordering back to previous fuse order (quick toggle) to see if eviction pattern normalizes.
Kai: If kernel ordering fixes it, we need a per-runtime canary flag in rollout system to avoid host-wide kernel swap for stable users.
Jonah: Also document an emergency fallback: if EntropySentinel >= 1.5 -> immediate global halt for promote + paged on-call. Keep the MRR smoothing window to 10m before firing sentinel to avoid batch noise.
Priya: I'll prepare the eval harness and upload the seed corpus + severity taxonomy. Tagging SRE for kernel toggle.
Marta: locking actions and owners in thread: throttle/pin/seed-run -> OpsBot + Marta; fp16 build -> ModelBuildTeam; mixed-quant sweep -> Kai; kernel toggle infra -> SRE. Will post links when runs start. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Jonah: Thanks. If seeded run shows fp16 ~= baseline and mixed-quant recovers the anchor slice, plan a 0.5% incremental canary with per-layer pins rather than full rollout.
EntropyBot: Monitoring: seeded job queued; will post summary artifact in thread when complete.
Marta: great, thanks all. Will update once the seeded eval artifacts and KV traces are in. :eyes:
